simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מִלֻּאָה (H4396) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: מִלֻּאָה (milluʼâh) means a filling , i.e. setting (of gems) First listed occurrence: Exod 28 17.

definitions.full: H4396. milluah [ מִלֻּאָה ] noun feminine setting of jewel (compare verb Pi`el 2, Pu`al ); — construct מִלֻּאַת Exod 28:17 ׳מ אֶבֶן (as accusative of cognate meaning with מִלֵּא ); compare suffix מִלּוּאֹתָם ( ׳מִלֻּא ) 28:20 ; 39:13 .
